question:
Study the given pattern carefully and select the letter that can replace the question mark (?) in it.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/354c0a99602ac07b0ca74edd9aa839a7ffea0056da84fc7dd22ff0882ab4a48c.png]
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2d26a4107141c8988092be3a6f971de10fd85269bdcee88518465cc72c114f65.png] 

Given: [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/354c0a99602ac07b0ca74edd9aa839a7ffea0056da84fc7dd22ff0882ab4a48c.png] 

The logic followed here is:

J (10) - B (2) = H (8)

R (18) - M (13) = E (5)

Similarly,

? - I (9) = K (11)

? = I (11) + K (9) 

? = T (20) 

Hence, **T **is the correct answer.
